title: Horn of Africa Drought Tracker Update — Oct 18, 2026
summary: FEWS NET's 6 Oct special report warns that El Niño and a positive Indian Ocean Dipole may bring flood-scale rainfall to areas weakened by consecutive droughts. It flags a risk of Famine (IPC 5) in southern Somalia under a 1997/98-scale flood, though not the most likely scenario. Somalia needs peak Oct–Dec, Kenya Oct–Nov, and southern Ethiopia Jan–Mar 2027.
